verdict.rationale: Airwallex offers Hosted Payment Page and drop-in elements which are standard tokenization/hosted-field approaches that keep raw card data off merchant servers, implicitly supporting reduced PCI DSS scope, but there is no explicit documentation discussing PCI DSS compliance scope reduction, SAQ eligibility, or tokenization guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit PCI DSS SAQ-A scope statements, tokenization/vaulting API details, and any compliance certification documentation (e.g., PCI DSS Level 1 attestation) referencing merchant scope reduction.
